10.answer: Illustrate five observations: Earth’s circular shadow in lunar eclipses; a departing ship’s hull disappearing first; circumnavigation; different stars visible at different latitudes; and satellite photographs showing a globe. Label each sketch and explain the observation.
10.explanation: These observations support a curved Earth. Measurements show its equatorial radius is slightly larger than its polar radius.
